text: will you add a feature that will let me align all the verts on a loop in one motion since coming back and aligning these is a pain [Image #1]
resolution: Added Align Loop as a native, journaled mesh transform for one connected unbranched vertex path or authored edge loop. It chooses the least-varying model axis, flattens the welded selection to its centroid in one operation, preserves selection, participates in Mirror Edit through the existing transform core, and refuses branched/disconnected/already-flat input without mutation. Exposed the action in the model toolbar/context menu and Edit > Mesh > Transform, assigned A in Vertex/Edge modes, and added Agent Seat parity. Verified 188/188 native mesh tests, command and Seat API test bundles, a clean scoped diff, and a ReleaseFast editor ship build.
